retrieved_passages.content: The generator reduces order volume in September 2025 relative to the surrounding seasonal baseline. retrieved_passages.title: evidence queries
retrieved_passages.content:
-- Delivery timeliness by month; one row per fulfillment/order.
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', delivered_date) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS delivered_shipments,
       SUM(CASE WHEN date(delivered_date) <= date(promised_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_shipments
FROM fulfillment
WHERE delivery_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

retrieved_passages.title: kpi definitions
retrieved_passages.content: - **On-time delivery rate:** fulfilled delivered orders delivered on or before `promised_delivery_date`, divided by fulfilled delivered orders with both dates present.
